text: PCRAFI utilizes the Pacific Risk Information System (PacRIS) to house country-specific exposure inventories and hazard layers, supporting planning and fiscal risk assessment. It offers sovereign climate and disaster risk insurance, providing rapid liquidity post-disaster. The initiative has developed new insurance products for excessive rainfall and drought, expanding coverage beyond tropical cyclones and earthquakes. Governance and capacity building are integral, with training for national agencies to use PacRIS and interpret model outputs.
